name: Asagiri Tours
blurb: Four drivers and two guides working the Fuji lakes. They will not run a sunrise day if the forecast says cloud below 900 metres.

name: Rakusai Walks
blurb: Walking guides in Kyoto and Nara. Every day is on foot and local trains, with a maximum of eight people.

name: Yomichi Guides
blurb: Tokyo guides who work the old wards by day and the alleys after dark.

name: Kuidaore Walks
blurb: Food guides in Osaka. They book the stops the day before so nobody queues.

name: Kita Line Tours
blurb: Cars and drivers across Hokkaido and northern Honshu, in summer and in snow.
